taipei-yangmingshan-and-north-coast.title: Taipei · Yangmingshan and North Coast
taipei-yangmingshan-and-north-coast.slogan: A 69 km loop out of Yangmingshan
taipei-yangmingshan-and-north-coast.story: Volcanic hills and sea air close to the city. 69 km round from Taipei - plan on about 1 h 20 of riding. The stops in between: Jinshan coast, Yehliu geopark and Keelung. Yangmingshan is the high point. It is a high-mountain day.

sections.advice: This Jinshan coast → Yehliu geopark stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
sections.imageAudit: OK: v2.4 section media query tied to local section endpoints

sections.advice: Yehliu geopark → Keelung food is the reward section in Taipei. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
sections.imageAudit: OK: v2.4 section media query tied to local section endpoints

sections.advice: Keelung food → Back to Yangmingshan is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.title: Yangmingshan → Jinshan coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
